name: unbox-box
description: An F1 analysis web app an AI agent can drive. Unofficial fan project.

scripts.data: cd pipeline && uv run unbox-box-pipeline build --season 2025 --event "Italian Grand Prix" --session Qualifying --out ../apps/web/public/data && uv run unbox-box-pipeline build --season 2025 --event "Italian Grand Prix" --session Race --out ../apps/web/public/data
scripts.data:sync: cd pipeline && uv run unbox-box-pipeline sync
scripts.data:publish: cd pipeline && uv run --with huggingface_hub unbox-box-pipeline publish
scripts.dev:full: npm run data:serve & NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_BASE=http://localhost:4100 npm run dev
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run spell && npm run knip && npm test
